summary: Verified logo text fix in TopBar. The h1.logo-gradient now renders a single text node 'ALIZCETV' (8 chars, no inner span) with the cyan-indigo-violet gradient applied uniformly. 'LIVING ROOM EDITION' subtitle visible. Streaming grid shows all 10 tiles including YouTube and IPTV. No React console errors. Edge app-mode cinema launch could not be verified (Electron-only, not runnable in web preview).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo fix verified.
